title: SkyrimNet Brothel
tagline: Run your own brothel: register workers, send customers to them or take customers yourself, and SkyrimNet's AI voices every offer and answer while SexLab plays the scene.
description:
SkyrimNet Brothel lets you turn any interior into a brothel, and you can run up to three of them at once. You register workers, women or men (followers or anyone else, or all your followers at once), or let the brothel hire workers of its own, and customers walk up to them and make paid offers. SkyrimNet's AI writes and voices each offer and the worker's answer, the worker can accept or refuse, and SexLab plays the scene on a free bed, with double beds chosen first.

You can also take customers yourself and answer them by picking AI-written lines in the dialogue menu, including which position you want, or buy a worker's company with your own gold. The choice system is built into the mod, so SkyrimNet Player Choices is not needed.

People from the brothel's town can walk over during opening hours and become customers, and you can choose whether customers are men, women or both. Workers and customers who know each other, such as friends, lovers or regulars, talk like it, and relatives never do business together. You can name yourself or an NPC as the owner, who takes a share of every payment, recommends workers to customers and talks to the workers about their takings. Experienced workers invite customers on their own, workers chat among themselves between customers, and the brothel and every worker gain levels from 1 to 10 that change how they feel about the work.

Customers pay up front and get their gold back if the deal falls through. Everything is set up in an MCM with six pages, and a Manage Brothel power opens a menu with the main settings while you play. The mod requires SexLab P+ (SexLab 1.6x is supported but has not been tested in game), MCM Helper, PapyrusUtil and powerofthree's Papyrus Extender, and UIExtensions is needed only for the Manage Brothel power. A Japanese translation is available as a separate archive.
author: taka
changelog: 0.3.1: Your followers are no longer picked as customers unless the new setting Followers can be customers is on. In a scene you are in yourself, pressing Space no longer makes you jump out of the animation, because the brothel puts SexLab P+'s hold back on you. A scene that SexLab accepted but never played is now ended, so mods that follow running scenes no longer keep working on it. 0.3.0: Any adult man can now be registered as a worker, and a new setting decides whether the brothel hires women, men or both. Workers and customers who know each other, such as friends, lovers, rivals or regulars, talk like it, and someone the worker knows is picked as their customer first. Relatives never do business together, and a relative who finds a worker in the brothel reacts on the spot instead. When you do not work in the brothel yourself, you can buy a worker's company with your own gold. The settings menu is reordered under headings, the number of the brothel's own customers can go down to zero, and several menu buttons pressed in one visit now all run.
